## Activity

During January 2025, East City Eye Clinic recorded 179 captures. This report summarises activity, image quality, and grading for the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded capture total provides the activity measure for the reporting period and is used as the basis for the image-quality rate reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 179 captures, 5 were marked ungradable by graders. This represented an ungradable rate of 2.8 per cent. The result is reported alongside the total activity to provide a clear view of the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. No further breakdown of the ungradable captures is included in this report.

## Grading

Grading identified 41 referable results during January 2025. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 9 days. These figures provide the monthly summary of grading output and timeliness for East City Eye Clinic. The referable result count and median lag are reported together to support review of the service’s grading activity during the period.
